repository.name: HA-Energy-Price-Engine
repository.description: A modular Home Assistant integration that automatically retrieves, calculates and stores complete electricity prices, including spot prices, grid tariffs, supplier fees, taxes and VAT. Provides persistent 15-minute price data for EV charging, heating, battery storage and smart energy automation.

release.name: v0.1.0-beta.9 — finish setup and inspect verified price components
release.body:
Beta.9 fixes the remaining beta.8 setup and device-diagnostic usability issues from #8 and #10. **Done – return to integration** explicitly finishes already-saved native Options. Current Unknown values now have actionable availability explanations, and the device shows eight actual stored price components.

**HACS prerelease for development Home Assistant acceptance.** Exact immutable source **6c588323786cc5f8f696d553e02213ef8b169286**; tag **v0.1.0-beta.9**. [PR #14](https://github.com/NicolaiTandrup/HA-Energy-Price-Engine/pull/14) remains draft/unmerged. Main and beta.1–.8 releases/tags/assets preserved. No stable/production/control changes.

## Update with HACS

1. Back up development HA. Open Energy Price Engine in HACS, persist **Show beta versions**, refresh information and select **v0.1.0-beta.9**. Download, restart HA and reload the app/browser; Device info must show **0.1.0-beta.9**. Keep existing entries.
2. Open **Configure**. Use **Done – return to integration**, row-level editing or **Check prices**. Accepted steps are already saved. The initial installation flow uses HA’s native settings-saved completion notice; it does not create another site.
3. On the device, inspect **Component period**, the eight component amounts, **Prices now — availability**, **Today statistics — availability**, **Tomorrow prices — availability** and the exact **Verified prices begin** time.
4. New installs default technical duplicates and unused provisional sensors off. Upgrades preserve enabled entity choices. Optionally use **Configure → Technical diagnostics** to deselect only unused canonical rows; keep any used by automations or Recorder. IDs/history stay, disabled entities stop new sensor samples, and the CM API continues independently.
5. The beta.8 dashboard remains supported. If using it, change the registered local JavaScript resource query to `?v=0.1.0-beta.9` and reload. Both graphs, complete tables and today’s DSO ranges remain. [Setup guide](https://github.com/NicolaiTandrup/HA-Energy-Price-Engine/blob/v0.1.0-beta.9/docs/WIZARD_GUIDE.md) · [HACS procedure](https://github.com/NicolaiTandrup/HA-Energy-Price-Engine/blob/v0.1.0-beta.9/docs/HACS_DISTRIBUTION.md) · [Acceptance checklist](https://github.com/NicolaiTandrup/HA-Energy-Price-Engine/blob/feat/beta5-simple-onboarding/docs/BETA_ACCEPTANCE.md).

## Understand the component amounts and Unknown

Device diagnostics show **Nord Pool spot, Radius/DSO, Energinet network, Energinet system, supplier markup and electricity tax excluding VAT; applied VAT amount; verified final marginal price including VAT once**. Fixed **øre/kWh, two decimals**, independent of the main display preference. Amounts, source, effective metadata and revision come from actual stored verified records. The applied VAT amount is the sum recorded for each component; mixed VAT bases/negative values are retained. Rounded rows can differ by0.01 from a rounded total. Fixed subscriptions remain excluded.

**Component period** explicitly identifies the current verified quarter or **Next quarter — current quarter unavailable**. When first prices begin next quarter, Final now correctly stays Unknown; availability explains the activation boundary and shows the exact start time. At that boundary, current pricing/period update automatically. Full-day statistics remain unavailable when earlier quarters are missing; a complete verified future CM window can still be Ready. Separate guidance distinguishes loading, tomorrow publication, missing tariffs/contracts, stale verification and genuine source/storage errors. No unverified past backfill, fabricated zeros or weaker readiness.

Ordinary statuses use localized **Ready / Incomplete / Stale / Error**. Existing advanced canonical uppercase states, DKK/kWh, entity IDs, Recorder units and CM APIv1 remain unchanged. All9 engine/source/SQLite/coordinator/scheduler/component-math/API files are byte-identical published beta.8. Required13:05/13:20/13:40/23:59/00:01 refreshes retained. Historical EWII0.030DKKexVAT remains June–September2026 only; no future/private contract or heating guesses.

## Validation and integrity

**333 producer tests/core** HA2026.10.3/current2026.10.4, **89% coverage**, zero skips; two unchanged upstream HACS deprecation warnings. Unchanged CM suites **153/176/227/228/core**, plus2 coupled runtime cases/reference/core. **17 locked browser regressions**, Ruff, official hassfest1valid/0invalid, HACS/translations and both clean native ZIP layouts outside source. All19 exact-source push/PR/tag/draft checks must pass before upload.

Native HA.4/frontend20260930.5, desktop1440x1000/mobile390x844 EN/DA passes Done/close/reopen, eight numerical components/VAT/source, exact activation, user preferences and preserved dashboard graphs/tables/revisions. A fresh first-activation run observed the **actual unpatched20:00CET clock boundary**: Unknown/currentIncomplete→Ready/current equals exact priorNext, component scope next→current, historyIncomplete/tomorrowReady, no backfill. All8 native amounts/source/revision match exact SQLite snapshots. Upgrade preserves6configs/168original IDs/4logical ledgers; restart preserves7configs/287IDs/5ledgers while adding an eighth QA site. All14 original Recorder unit identities retained. Provider counters unchanged on reads; zero browser errors/warnings. **27 actual screenshot hashes/data** in the [simulation receipt](https://github.com/NicolaiTandrup/HA-Energy-Price-Engine/blob/v0.1.0-beta.9/docs/receipts/v0.1.0-beta.9-simulation.json). Synthetic/recorded software evidence, **not owner real-HA acceptance**.

Two fresh post-publication jobs independently verify public metadata/tag/main/assets, actual pinned HACS2.0.5/upstream registration/beta8→9 installation/update/uninstall/reinstall and both native ZIP layouts on both cores. Original public beta8 ZIP is downloaded/hash-verified first; real SQLite history survives HACS operations. Beta8 selects9, current9 stays current and stable excludes prereleases/hashes. Their results are committed to the [public verification receipt](https://github.com/NicolaiTandrup/HA-Energy-Price-Engine/blob/feat/beta5-simple-onboarding/docs/receipts/v0.1.0-beta.9.json) after both complete.

SHA256:
- HACS ZIP: `b95058c3a25fc393ee9052b4d9daf83af2da2487858e7522b8138d9fd5c87c31`
- Manual ZIP: `58d0679d98925eb846ee1d1e189aff5ff0ff49f88a724550d93eb6a88fcfa6bc`
- Download `BUILD_MANIFEST.json` and `SHA256SUMS` for exact source/member checks.

## Remaining limits

Existing enabled canonical diagnostics are preserved intentionally: cleaning an existing device is an explicit user selection. HA can truncate long status/name rows; open the entity for complete details. Initial native installation ends with HA’s supported settings-saved notice; Options Done returns directly to the integration. Unsubmitted form typing is not durable until the native form is submitted. All-in sources cannot reveal unknown component splits. User precision overrides remain user-owned. Dashboard requires its one-time local Resource registration and covers today/tomorrow.

Private contract/VAT/grid/heating values, live provider availability and physical mobile/hardware acceptance remain owner checks. Public national rates are bounded; no future EWII inference. **Cloud benchmarks do not establish Raspberry Pi performance**; original SQLite improvement and historical API retained. HACS external branding can fall back.

No production HA, Node-RED, Tesla/Easee, CM source or charging commands touched. No stable release or main merge. Stop after beta.9 publication and independent verification.
